product_metadata.title: BY Mistletoe Vacuum Sealer Machine, Automatic Food Saver with Powerful Air Sealing System (-60Kpa), Dry & Mist Food Saving Machine & LED Indicator Lights (20 bags), 15.15x12.5INCH
description: 💞I don’t know what to do if I buy too much ingredients? This black food sealing machine can easily help me solve this problem. Automatic Vacuum Sealer Food Saving Vacuum fresh food exhaust part of the air in the packaging container,thereby protecting food. Space Saving When bulk food occupies the freezer space, you can use bags to seal them and stack them in the refrigerator. Time Saving: Prepare your meals, seal them and freeze them. Ideal for baby food preparation too, especially for working parents with limited time. Technical Specs: * Rated Voltage: 110/220V * Rated Frequency: 50Hz * Rated Power: 70W/300W * Sealing Time: 4 ~ 6 seconds * Vaccum Pressure: -60kPa - 0kPa * Max Sealing Length: 11 inch * Construction Material: ABS * Dimension: 13.5x 5.1 x 2.3 inch * N.W: 1.5lb Fully Kits: * 20 x Heat-seal bags * 1 x User Manual * 1 x Vacuum Sealer * 1 x Power line
